insight: Founded in 2020 in Sydney, Australia; raised a $24M Series B led by Bessemer in 2025, with offices now in Sydney and San Francisco.
name: Relevance AI
tagline: Build and manage a workforce of AI agents for business processes.
description: A platform for building, deploying, and managing teams of AI agents that autonomously run business processes — from lead qualification to customer support — with human oversight and governance. Agents and multi-agent 'workforces' are assembled with a no-code builder and a library of tools and triggers. Pricing is usage-based on 'actions' rather than per-agent, and every plan includes unlimited agents. The former free tier has been retired; paid plans start at $19/mo (Pro, billed annually) and add seats, scheduling, and BYO-LLM.

modelSupport.notes: Uses managed models by default; paid tiers allow bringing your own LLM.

changelog.summary: Pricing moved from freemium to paid — the free tier (200 actions/mo) was retired for new and existing accounts; paid plans now start at $19/mo (Pro, billed annually).

edge: Prices on 'actions' with unlimited agents on every tier, so cost tracks work done rather than per-agent headcount.
